body:
## 18 October 2026 — latest exact-head verification

**Do not merge. PR remains DRAFT, with the previous corrective document artifacts intact.** Verified at exact head `3cb1030ae4c636fc18245ed8ae23ebb967e5407d`, against main `021379856d07611752832b44bfe951d6ae36f0b2`.

[Latest exact-head CI run #39125899080](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/actions/runs/39125899080): **FAILURE**. I inspected the actual governance job log: it runs `python -I scripts/run_pr_compliance.py`, then fails `[Errno 2] No such file or directory` on the old PR77 checkout. This occurs *before* the merged compliance evaluator or handoff validator executes; it is not a draft-only red gate, a syntax error in CP0012, or an application test failure. The independent source reviewer confirmed the corrected CP0012's deterministic contract/input/blob integrity, not a passing Python validator.

**Owner decision / pre-integration gate:** Either (A) explicitly dispatch **Codex** to create a NEW compliant integration branch from current `main` with a fresh task, committed/validated ContextPack, provenance-preserving adoption of the original ChatGPT LANGUAGE.md and scoped AGENTS section, manifest/ExecutionBundle and exact-head CI; or (B) independently verify a **task-specific ChatGPT executor exception in reviewed `main`** first, then commission a new-base compliant implementation. Do not create `status: owner-verified` through this assistant's candidate branch, reattribute authorship to Codex, overwrite PR76's AGENTS policy or disable the runner. Source-only PR77 head cannot pass effective main checks by merely toggling Draft/Ready. Owner semantic approval of 15 proposed labels and actual merge remain separate.

---

## PR77 — language candidate, corrected handoff and post-PR76 integration hold

### Corrective facts (18 October 2026)
- **Canonical IDs:** Merged [PR76](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/pull/76) owns Task/CP/EB0010. PR77's previously conflicting 0010 files were removed. Its replacement **0011** task/pack/bundle was subsequently found malformed: CP0011 contained `**Acceptance criteria:` rather than `**Acceptance criteria:**`. The original commits are preserved; **the original CP0011 was NOT valid pre-edit** despite an earlier unsupported ChatGPT self-check. Do not rewrite that history.
- **New current corrective records:** [Task0012](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/docs/vel-language-standard-20261017/docs/agent-workflow/tasks/VEL-TASK-0012.yaml), [CP0012](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/docs/vel-language-standard-20261017/docs/agent-workflow/context-packs/VEL-CP-0012.md), [EB0012](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/docs/vel-language-standard-20261017/docs/agent-workflow/execution-bundles/VEL-EB-0012.md) and [source map](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/docs/vel-language-standard-20261017/docs/agent-workflow/inputs/VEL-TASK-0012/PR77-HANDOFF-SUPERSESSION.md). Task0012 committed `0d217dc1` then CP0012 committed `7189cc8` **before** retiring the defective current-tree Task/CP/EB0011. Source snapshot equality and complete task-contract string were checked independently against seven exact original blob IDs; correct `**Acceptance criteria:**` verified. Full Python validator was NOT executed locally, so the deterministic reproduction is not falsely labeled script execution.
- **Product documentation preserved:** [LANGUAGE.md](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/docs/vel-language-standard-20261017/LANGUAGE.md) retains candidate/proposed status, 15 unapproved naming decisions and accurate Section15.4 wording. [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/blob/docs/vel-language-standard-20261017/AGENTS.md) includes the language integration; future integration must **preserve merged PR76's newest agent/compliance text** rather than overwrite it.
- **Prior authorship:** Original Git history credits ChatGPT as the direct executor, not Codex. Invalid CP0010 and CP0011 chronology is disclosed in Task0012 source map/EB; historical pinned blobs were not rewritten.

### Main changed during work — required next integration
PR76 is now merged on actual main `021379856d07611752832b44bfe951d6ae36f0b2`. PR77 remains based on pre-PR76 `f371448...`, so it lacks the effective `scripts/run_pr_compliance.py` required by the merged workflow. [PR77 exact-head CI39075869168](https://github.com/Ben-001-sys/Vellistry/actions/runs/39075869168) failed with **missing runner**, not a product-language/SQL defect. Old ready-green runs on former main cannot certify current rules. The new correction's CI results must be checked by exact current head as generated.

**Owner-only prerequisite:** A proposed/new-base continuation that keeps ChatGPT as executor requires a task-specific `docs/agent-workflow/authorizations/VEL-TASK-NNNN.yaml` owner-verified exception *already in reviewed main* with the evidence URL, under `docs/agent-workflow/PR-COMPLIANCE.md`. The owner may instead dispatch a new scoped Codex integration, preserving original ChatGPT history. **Do not self-create/forge that owner-verified record on this candidate branch.** After owner checkpoint: new main-based task, genuinely validated committed pack before *new* implementation, truthful adopted origins, compliance manifest, AGENTS text reconciliation, ready/exact-head CI and explicit owner merge decision. Task0012 is a documentation correction, **not** that approved new-base task.

### Scope and security
No application/UI behavior, SQL, migrations, provider charges, CI policy, secrets, private manuscripts, deployments, branch-protection changes or merges performed here. Owner has not approved the 15 proposed product-language decisions by authorizing file implementation.

**Reviewer disposition:** Correction02 evidence is ready for review; **final integration remains blocked** on owner-reviewed new-base executor/authorization workflow. Keep PR in draft until that is resolved.
